name: openchamber-modelselect
description: Host-rendered Work Status section (contributes.statusSection.source) surfacing the modelselect plugin's project pick plus the auto-update-router switch, a settings panel for the plugin options and the extension config, and a session action that shows the pick.

scripts.build: openchamber-guest-bundle --node service/src/main.js service/main.js && openchamber-guest-bundle panel/src/main.js panel/main.js && openchamber-guest-bundle background/src/main.js background/main.js
scripts.check: node --check service/main.js && node --check panel/main.js && node --check background/main.js && openchamber-guest-check .
